cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ameth: Replaces a projectile with a native amethyst cluster. Retains native impact particles and sounds. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lionf: Replaces a projectile with a native lionfish spike. Successful hits retain native Poison I for 3 seconds. Amplify changes direct damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bolt_: Summons a native lightning column at the selected location after a short delay. Amplify changes damage as for Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.increase_damag: Increases damage by the configured Harm amplification amount.
cataclysm_nouveau.augment.decrease_damag: Decreases damage by the configured Harm amplification amount.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_: Raises a native Void Rune on nearby ground at the selected location, retaining its attack animation and damage timing. Amplify increases each hit by the same amount as Harm.
cataclysm_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame: Erupts a native Flame Jet from nearby ground at the selected location. Retains native particles, sound and five-second ignition. Amplify increases direct damage by the same amount as Harm.
